subject: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Team — kicking off annual planning for FY27. High-level asks and timeline below; please read through and reply with any major blockers by EOD Wed. I want us to start from a common set of scenarios so leadership and finance can align on guidance to the board.

Goals for this thread:
- Agree on three planning scenarios: Base (most likely), Upside (+20–30% ARR), Downside (-10–15% or hiring freeze).
- Capture key drivers by org (ARR, headcount, cloud costs, Dedicated sales commitments).
- Deliverables: filled planning template, a headcount plan, and a reconciled top-line model.
- Timeline: templates out today, org-level inputs due Oct 16, consolidated review Oct 20–22, leadership QBR prep Oct 26.

Attached: planning_timeline_v1.pptx (draft timeline). Simone — looping you in for the template and to help run the consolidation.

Action items: please confirm who will own the org-level model (sales, product, infra, people). I propose:
- Aditya: ARR & bookings assumptions, sales capacity plan
- Monica: GTM staffing plan & hiring priority list
- Laura: finance consolidation & headcount cost model
- Evelyn: infra and cloud cost scenarios + savings levers

If any of you think the dates are unrealistic, call it out now.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein | VP Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Thanks Markus — this looks actionable. A few quick notes:
- I will own consolidation and will need a standardized headcount manifest (title, comp band, FTE effective date) and any variable comp assumptions.
- For cost modeling, please include expected vendor commitments (marketplace, infra partners) and any pre-paid credits we expect to use in FY27.
- Can Monica own the headcount manifest? Monica — if you can start a shared sheet (by team) and drop a first pass by Oct 12 that would help.

Simone — if you have a template for the consolidated model, please share (we'll adapt).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Agree with the approach. Couple of sales-specific requests:
- I'll model ARR lines by cohort (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and need guidance on net logo/expansion targets for Base vs Upside. Suggest we assume +18% net revenue retention for Base, +24% for Upside.
- Pipeline coverage: I'll send a short extraction of Weighted Pipeline by Oct 9. Please let me know if we should include partner marketplace revenue as a separate line item (I prefer yes, given growing deals).
- Need clarity on quota resets/hiring for sales FY27 — if hiring is limited in Downside, that impacts bookings assumptions.

I'll start a draft ARR model and attach to the template once Simone shares it.

Thanks — Aditya
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Hi all — attaching the Annual_Planning_Template_2027.xlsx and a short QBR_Prework_Guide.pdf. The template has tabs for: revenue model (cohort lines), headcount manifest, opex lines (cloud/third-party), and sensitivity scenarios. Guidance: keep Base conservative (market comps), Upside should reflect acceleration from product releases + Dedicated deals pipeline.

Attachment: Annual_Planning_Template_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: QBR_Prework_Guide.pdf (doc)

I'll be available to run a consolidation call the week of Oct 19 — propose Oct 20 10:00–11:30 PT. If that works, I can draft a consolidated slide for the Oct 22 leadership review.

Best,
Simone Park
Principal, Quoin Advisors

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Thanks — I'll own cloud/infra scenarios. Initial asks from infra:
- Provide current 12mo run-rate by cost center (GPU, Storage, Networking, Marketplace spend).
- Identify two levers for savings: (1) aggressive quantization rollout on non-latency-critical models, (2) spot-instance burst strategy for Dedicated batch workloads.

I'll drop a first-pass cost breakdown to the shared folder by Oct 12.

Evelyn
Director, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>, Linda Morales <linda@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Good cadence — quick logistics update:
- Monica: please create the headcount manifest sheet under the shared Drive link and set edit permissions for listed contributors. Use the template Simone attached and name it "Headcount_Manifest_BY_TEAM.xlsx".
- Laura: finance will accept manifests through Oct 16; please flag any late submissions and escalate to me.
- Aditya: pipeline extract due Oct 9; label any strategic deals (> $250k) and indicate likely close quarter.
- Evelyn: include expected infra savings assumptions as a separate tab.

I'll schedule the consolidation call for Oct 20 10:00–11:30 PT (Simone confirmed). Calendar invite will follow — tentative: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=planning-20261020

One ask for leadership review: bring a one-slide summary per org with the primary risk and one mitigation. That will keep the Oct 22 session crisp.

Thanks — Markus

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Simone Park <simone@quoinadvisors.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning & budget kickoff — targets, scenarios, timeline

Acknowledged. I'll confirm the consolidation owners and will post the Drive links and the Headcount_Manifest_BY_TEAM.xlsx by EOD. I'll also add a short tab for variable comp assumptions.

Laura
